mona: Quick sync — planning prioritization for the Q2 rollout choreography. Need to decide how we sequence the three experiments (prefix-cache, quant-fallback, cost-routing) across hosted + dedicated customers. Prefer something that balances customer asks vs risk. @eli @raj
eli: Agree. We should adjust RICE scoring to account for experiment interactions (not independent). Example: reduce 'reach' when two experiments target same route.
raj: Customer asks push routing-by-cost higher. But that's risky for latency-sensitive customers. We need strict guardrails and a way to opt-out per account.
tessa: Proposed launch criteria (short):
• success metric: CTR on generated suggestions >= baseline
• perf: p95 latency <= 250ms for hosted; <= 300ms for dedicated
• cost: per-token cost delta <= 8%
Also need rollout eval harness and holdout prompts.
sam: SRE: fallback paths must be automatic and tested. My checklist:
1) canary traffic cutover < 5% → monitor
2) auto-fallback if error-rate > 2% or p95 regresses > 30%
3) circuit-breaker for hot shards
eli: For sequencing I propose:
1) small canary (2 instances, 0.5% traffic) for prefix-cache — low-risk
2) canary for quant-fallback on a dedicated pool (0.5%) with perf tests
3) routing-by-cost as staged experiment (start at 1%) with account opt-out
We'll keep routing last because it changes traffic shape.
mona: Love that. One more ask: how do we score impact vs effort during planning thread? Suggestion: we keep RICE numbers but add an 'interference' multiplier (0.7-1.0) when experiments overlap.
raj: Agree. For customer-driven asks we'll have an accelerated path but require stricter rollbacks and a 24h support on-call during ramp.
tessa: I'll prep an eval set and baseline prompts today, include edge cases for long context.
sam: I'll draft the rollout playbook and failure scenarios. Will add scripts for rollback: `redwood rollout rollback --id $RUN_ID --to stable`
deploy-bot: Canary for prefix-cache started (run_id: rc-20260320-81) — monitoring attached
mona: OK — action items: @tessa eval set, @sam playbook + rollback scripts, @eli config for interference multiplier in RICE, @raj coordinate customer opt-out UI. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
